items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You told Sonny that already, did you? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I didn't tell that because I forgot about it.

ctx.x: See, but I -- later years, when I was about 16, 17, I got on the circuit, the shows -- see, I was with Alabama too, but I was just remembering one time (inaudible) I was with that and the Alabama Minstrel and the Georgia Minstrel.
You told Sonny that already, did you?
No, I didn't tell that because I forgot about it.
